name: Seth
message: We love and miss you Teddy

name: Matt
message: I didn't know Teddy too much, but he was adorable and very well behaved the few times i had the pleasure of seeing him. I know you're in a better place being the best boy you always were. You are missed, you are loved.

name: Mema Lee Ann
message: Dear Teddy Bear, you gave so much love to my baby your Mommy and your Daddy, and enough to share with your Mema. Love you, miss you! Run free of all your pain my beautiful soul. Love you forever.

name: James
message: Teddy, after a long and well lived life that was filled with loved you get some well deserved rest. Keep cuddling in the hearts of those you touched! My Love to you

name: Leah
message: Teddy was a fluffy, beautiful boy and the world is a little less bright without him in it. Thinking of you guys during this difficult time. 'If love could have saved you, you would have lived forever'

name: Ryan
message: Teddy was truly a King and will be missed dearly!

name: Roxann
message: Well Teddy was the man or at least he thought he was. Quickly running to the door kind of jump barking at you till he was picked up. Then quiet till he was put down again. Such a fiesty little guy.I remember Seth telling me whenever he got into bed Teddy would try to intimidate him out of it. Kayla was his how dare he. But as time went on they came to an understanding that Kayla was both of theirs. So they became family and added to it because they had love to share. And there lies the thing that will be missed and we grieve. It is the space that love occupied that is vacant now. The physical expression of it anyways. But Teddy is with you as he is with me in writing this. I also will miss the little guy. But I think the memory that is clearest to me. And kind of sums things up was during covid. You guys would come over with the dogs abit. It was a chilly evening. Teddy wanted to get next to Kayla who had a blanket.  He was just sitting there patiently waiting for her to get things adjusted and just right for him.  When all was done he snuggled contentedly.  Kayla looked up and laughed saying 'I know he is spoiled.  But he's my little man'.  Thats what loving does to us and we are bette for it.
